Adani Enterprises Raises ₹16,990 Crore through Qualified Institutional Placement

Adani Enterprises has successfully closed its ₹1,500 crore Qualified Institutions Placement, approving the allotment of over 5.2 crore equity shares at ₹2,883 each. The QIP reflects a 5% discount to its floor price, and shares are not registered under the U.S. Securities Act. This move comes as the market recovers from recent volatility, with investors seeking stable returns.
